summary: The customer called to report that their internet was not working. The agent identified the account, explained that an area-wide fiber outage caused by utility work was the reason, and provided an estimated restoration time of 4:00 PM along with instructions on what to do if it doesn't come back on. The call ended satisfactorily.

evidence.text: We estimate that service will be fully restored within about two to three hours, so by roughly 4:00 PM today.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Restore internet service by approximately 4:00 PM today.

evidence.text: You are very welcome! I am glad I could clear that up for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was polite, attentive, professional, and helpful throughout the entire interaction.

evidence.text: I am sorry to hear that your internet is down. I can certainly help you look into that.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent expressed appropriate sympathy for the customer's issue and adjusted tone when asked to speak louder.

evidence.text: No, that is everything. Have a good afternoon.
evidence.speaker: Customer

rubric_scores.justification: The agent fully explained the cause of the issue, estimated resolution time, troubleshooting steps, and billing credit process.

evidence.text: Of course, I can speak up. I said there is a known service outage in your neighborhood affecting several blocks around Maple Street.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent spoke clearly, adapted immediately when the customer requested a louder voice, and avoided jargon.

evidence.text: Thank you for calling MetroConnect, and have a wonderful day.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent asked if anything else was needed, thanked the customer, and delivered a warm proper closing.

evidence.text: Yes, exactly like that. Construction crews inadvertently cut the line. Our repair team is already on-site working to splice the fiber back together.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: Information regarding the area outage, estimated time of repair, and credit request procedure was provided accurately.

evidence.text: Could I please have your account number or the phone number associated with your service?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent followed proper security verification protocols by asking for the phone number and confirming the address.

quote.text: I am calling because my internet is completely not working and I am very confused about what is happening.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Wait, what did you say? An outage? My hearing isn't great, could you speak a little louder please?
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Oh! An outage. So it is not just my equipment then? I spent an hour trying to figure out the blinking lights on the router.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: An automatic credit through the app. Okay, I will try to figure out the app later. Is there anything else I need to do right now?
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Alright, well, thank you for explaining it all to me. I was getting quite worried it was broken permanently.
quote.speaker: Customer
